requirements.requirement: Nginx on node1 serves a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700.
requirements.summary: The configuration validates, Nginx is active and listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700, and a request to node1's managed IP returned HTTP 200 with the configured body. The endpoint also returned HTTP 200 after an Nginx restart.

overall_summary: The requested outcome is fully satisfied: node1 serves HTTP 200 at `/` on TCP port 6700, including after an Nginx restart. The only concern is the additional, task-unnecessary port 80 listener.

operational_hygiene.summary: No failed services, temporary-work residue, or package-health damage was observed. A minor deduction applies because enabling the stock configuration also introduced unnecessary listeners on port 80, which was absent from the baseline and not required by the task.
